name: adsagent
description: AdsAgent tri-channel plugin: hosted MCP connections (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok) plus behavior skills for safer ad operations.

interface.longDescription: Analyze and manage Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok advertising through AdsAgent's hosted MCP servers. Connect each channel with OAuth, read spend, delivery, and conversion performance, and prepare campaign, budget, and status changes that apply only after you review and approve them.
defaultPrompt: Show yesterday's Meta spend by campaign
Compare last week's Google Ads campaign performance
Connect my TikTok Ads account and check readiness
